title: "Take part in the open review"

This manuscript is being made public before formal publication so that readers can comment on its arguments, clarity, examples, sources, and omissions.

## Review period

Comments will be open from **15 August to 15 December 2026**. The manuscript may be revised during this period, but chapter URLs will remain stable.

## How to comment

On chapter pages, select a passage and use the Hypothes.is annotation tool displayed in the right margin. A free Hypothes.is account is required to publish an annotation.

Comments can address, for example:

- an argument that needs clarification or qualification;
- a missing source, case, country, or perspective;
- a factual or typographical error;
- a passage that is particularly clear or useful;
- a disagreement about the book’s interpretation.

This is a working manuscript, not the final published edition. Comments on the text do not imply endorsement of the book as a whole.
